record.question: Man of parts. Choose the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the idiom.
record.explanation: Answer A: talented. A “man of parts” is a person with notable abilities or talents. Independent check: A “man of parts” is a person with several talents or abilities. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/man%20of%20parts; https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/man-of-parts. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
